_note: The arena's modes (docs/RESEARCH_PHASE_11.md sections 13 and 14). Gun Run: one kill moves you to the next gun, a melee kill at the end wins (Apex's throwing knife), a melee death costs a level, 10 minutes then the highest level wins, health and shields come back after 4 s without damage. Apex plays it as 4 teams of 3 on 25 guns; ours is every player for themselves in the arena, on a short list of 10 or every gun. Team deathmatch: Apex is 6v6, first to 40, 10 minutes; the arena holds teams of up to 4, so ours is first to 30 (ours). Crown: Hyper Scape's Crown Rush (45 s to hold at launch); ours is a round mode, the crown appears 20 s in and 30 s of holding it takes the round (ours).

gunRun._knife: the last level: fists, whose hit is the throwing knife's 100 (Apex: 100 body, 300 head)
gunRun._regen: health and shields back per second once it starts (ours: Apex does not publish the rate)

_bots: bots added to a free-for-all (Gun Run, Crown) by the host's setting; team deathmatch fills both teams to teamSize
_spawns: arena coordinates (the 1v1 arena's centre is 0, 0; team A's end is -z, team B's +z), each facing up the map toward the middle
